data.summary:
Technical Lead / Senior .NET Engineer with 10+ years of experience delivering enterprise applications and cloud solutions using
C#, .NET Core/.NET 8, ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, React and Microsoft Azure. Hands-on experience across full-stack engineering, Azure
Functions and Durable Functions, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, SQL, application security, production troubleshooting and modernization.
Currently working with a global Microsoft client environment, contributing to enterprise products including AutoRI and WSD Hub,
with experience spanning feature delivery, integrations, cloud automation, security/compliance remediation and operational
support.
CORE TECHNOLOGIES

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Technical Lead | Wipro Limited | Jan 2022 – Present
Work on enterprise solutions for a global Microsoft client across .NET, React and Azure, providing technical ownership for feature
development, troubleshooting and engineering improvements.
Develop and maintain C#/.NET services, REST APIs and React-based user interfaces for enterprise applications including AutoRI
and WSD Hub.
Build and support Azure Functions and Durable Functions workflows used in automation and private-packaging/job-processing
scenarios.
Contribute to Azure DevOps, CI/CD, ARM-based infrastructure automation and PowerShell-driven VM/job workflows.
Worked on AutoRI private-packaging flows involving ASAP/DTP integrations, Azure Durable Functions, packaging VMs, Blob
Storage and operational logging.
Investigated and resolved Azure identity/authentication issues involving Managed Identity, DefaultAzureCredential, Key Vault
access and application authentication.
Contributed to .NET 6 to .NET 8 modernization and React/dependency upgrades while addressing compatibility and security
impacts.
Implemented and supported security/compliance improvements including HSTS, identity/access controls and remediation of high-
severity security findings.
Worked on S360/MISE compliance remediation, security vulnerability reduction and application hardening across enterprise
workloads.
Implemented telemetry improvements for job retry/status scenarios using Application Insights and supported Power BI reporting
using Azure DevOps, enterprise data and telemetry sources.
Collaborated with client stakeholders and distributed engineering teams to investigate production issues, deliver fixes, assess
technical risks and improve reliability.
Senior Software Engineer | Tata Consultancy Services | Aug 2018 – Jan 2022
Developed and supported enterprise software solutions using C#/.NET, APIs, SQL and Microsoft technologies for global clients.
Worked through the complete development lifecycle including requirement analysis, implementation, defect resolution, testing
support and production troubleshooting.
Collaborated with distributed teams and stakeholders to deliver application enhancements and resolve complex technical issues.
Software Developer | Travstarz Holidays & Destinations Pvt Ltd | Jun 2016 – Aug 2018 Akshay Gupta | Technical Lead – .NET / Azure / Full Stack
• Developed and maintained business applications using C#/.NET and JavaScript-based technologies.
• Delivered application enhancements, defect fixes and integration changes while supporting day-to-day production needs.
SELECTED PROJECT & ENGINEERING HIGHLIGHTS
AutoRI / Private Packaging: Worked on packaging workflows using Azure Durable Functions, PowerShell, packaging VMs, Blob
Storage and AzCopy-based log handling.
WSD Hub: Contributed to React-based enterprise UI development, security remediation, dependency modernization and
application reliability improvements.
Azure Identity: Troubleshot authentication and authorization failures involving Managed Identity, DefaultAzureCredential, Key
Vault and Azure application configuration.
Security & Compliance: Addressed S360/MISE requirements, HSTS implementation and high-severity dependency/security findings
while managing regression impact.
Cloud Modernization: Contributed to .NET 8 migration, Azure-based application improvements and modernization of supporting
dependencies and deployment workflows.
Observability & Reporting: Added telemetry coverage for retry/status scenarios and built/maintained Power BI reporting using
Azure DevOps, application telemetry and enterprise data.
